**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Strike</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

---

This flask is filled with a murky purple gas that briefly interferes with normal brain activity. A dread ampoule deals the listed mental damage and mental splash damage. On a hit, the target becomes [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19), or frightened 2 on a critical hit. Many types also grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
